16:13 Local Time, 15:13 GMT, 20:43 IST: Sri Lanka would be happy but I think there would be a feeling in their camp they could have pushed beyond 340. Mendis set it up with a hundred. Kamindu also got a fifty. And Rathnayake also played a fine hand but that final dash was missing. The last 10 overs went for 84 runs as England did manage to execute their plans well. Rehan Ahmed bowled a few vital overs at the death to ensure Lanka didn't get away. England would feel they could fielded better. The odd ball was stopping a little and England need to be a little careful about it. But it is still a flat track and England would back themselves. Lanka would want some magic with the ball. We will be back in 20 minutes time for the chase.

Back in 2006, England had set Sri Lanka a similar target (322) at this venue. The visitors chased it down in just 37.3 overs. That remains one of the only two successful 300-plus chases completed within 40 overs in ODIs, the other being India’s 321 (in 36.4 overs) against Sri Lanka in Hobart in 2012.
